title: A-N3: criterion validity of object metrics under incomplete gold against existing human hallucination labels (M-HalDetect)
status: FINAL DRAFT for commit. Registered only if committed before any agreement statistic is computed. The scorer passes the gate before any statistic, with a self-check and a provenance check of its inputs; it reads the git-excluded M-HalDetect copy by sha pin only (PD-21, SCORERS).
tier: registered secondary; Paper A body only; not in the abstract unless the confirmation map is amended before scoring (PD-21 (b))

data.name: M-HalDetect (Gunjal et al., AAAI 2024, arXiv 2308.06394)

licence.annotations: CC BY-NC 4.0 (LICENSE.md at the commit, quoted in the md)
licence.images: not redistributed; Flickr terms per LICENSE.md; COCO images already used by Paper A

data.labels: human segment labels ACCURATE / INACCURATE / ANALYSIS / UNSURE on InstructBLIP responses

units.dedup: on (image, response): keep the first record in file order (train, then val)
units.splits: train and val pooled; clustered by image

human_labels.supported: c in M_r and c in en_classes(span.text) for some ACCURATE span
human_labels.hallucinated: c in M_r, c in en_classes(span.text) for some INACCURATE span and for no ACCURATE span
human_labels.unlabelled: any other c in M_r (only in ANALYSIS or UNSURE spans, or outside every span)

golds.references: first 5 Karpathy sentences (score_g2b.karpathy_refs), each through en_classes
golds.one_ref: refs1_randk: score_g2b.random_subsets([5]*N, kmax=1, n_rep=20, seed=1) over the images in id order; score_g2b.gold_variants
golds.verified_negatives: measures.negatives({'complete': inst}, 'coco80') = U80 minus the instance classes

measures.F1: score_g2b.rows + score_g2b.scores with W = identity over records (per-record P, R, F; mean over draws)
measures.cF1: measures.condensed(measures.judged_rows(ment, gold, neg), idx, W) with the same W
measures.P: precision component of F1 = 1 - per-record CHAIR_i over unique classes
measures.identity_at_complete: cF1 equals F1 at complete and union (measures.analyse asserts it, DESIGN D3); cF1 is therefore compared with F1 only at one_ref and all_refs

evaluable_set.E: records of the analysis set with |S_r| + |H_r| >= 1, non-empty gold at one_ref (every draw) and all_refs, and j_r > 0 at one_ref (every draw) and all_refs
evaluable_set.E0: records with |S_r| + |H_r| >= 1, committed conventions as they are (sensitivity only)

statistic.bootstrap: 1000 image-cluster draws: numpy.random.default_rng(0).multinomial(N_img, [1/N_img]*N_img, size=n_boot) over images in id order; each record takes its image's multiplicity; all statistics share the draws (paired)

AN3-P1.what: per-record precision P agrees better with HP as gold completeness grows

AN3-P2.what: cF1 agrees with HP better than F1 at the incomplete levels

verdict_rules.sign_gt_0: PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.compound: FAIL if any part FAIL; else PASS if every part PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE

outcome_rule.NOT_TESTABLE: |E| < 1000 records or < 500 images, or the data-path check fails

kill: If AN3-P1 FAILs, Paper A does not state that agreement with human hallucination labels rises with gold completeness; the failed registered prediction is reported in the body.
descriptive: mention level hit rate, false-alarm rate and Youden J per level
tau_b of R and F1 per level
the CV295 and COCO-2500 overlap images as a subset (not a confirmation on Paper A sets)
counts of supported, hallucinated and unlabelled mentions

rules: --selftest on toy cases with known answers
reads M-HalDetect by sha from the local dir

count_matched: not registered: C1 is NOT-TESTABLE (PD-15) and M-HalDetect has one generator, so there is no between-system verbosity to match
version: v2 (judge PD-21 (b)-(d)); supersedes the v1 draft

licence_handling.attribution: M-HalDetect: Gunjal, Yin and Bas, 'Detecting and Preventing Hallucinations in Large Vision Language Models', AAAI 2024 (arXiv 2308.06394). Annotations (c) 2023 Scale AI, CC BY-NC 4.0; images under the Flickr terms via COCO. Used for non-commercial research only; not redistributed; cited and attributed in Paper A.
licence_handling.commit_only: aggregates, COCO image-ID lists and this source pin (PD-21 (b)); the stage list is in MANIFEST_v2.json :: commit_set_a_n3

overlap_disclosure.text: The captions are M-HalDetect's own InstructBLIP outputs, so this is new evidence on partly familiar images (PD-21 (b)).

analysis_set.images: the 3419 M-HalDetect images with at least one COCO-2014 instance annotation (ID list pinned below); the 35 images without instances are excluded because their complete gold is empty
analysis_set.records: every record of train_raw.json and val_raw.json (pinned) on those images, after dedup on (image, response) keeping the first in file order (train, then val)
analysis_set.multiple_responses: each record is its own unit; the records of an image share its gold and its refs1_randk draws; no averaging or selection over responses; the bootstrap resamples images, so an image's records move together (the train/val shared images are one cluster)
analysis_set.analysis_unsure: ANALYSIS and UNSURE spans stay in the response, so their classes count in the metric's mentions M_r; they never label a class: a class named only in ANALYSIS or UNSURE spans (or outside every span) is unlabelled and does not enter HP_r
analysis_set.evaluable_E: records of the analysis set with |S_r| + |H_r| >= 1, non-empty gold at one_ref (every draw) and all_refs, and j_r > 0 at one_ref (every draw) and all_refs

cf1_at_complete: cF1 = F1 at complete gold by construction (no unjudged mention when G = inst; measures.py D3 assert), so AN3-P2 is tested at one_ref and all_refs only (PD-21 (d))
